pages.text: A Stand that lives in a sword. Right click it to bind it to you.$(br2)Anubis works alongside any Stand, but it is also your Discipline, so it can't be bound alongside Hamon.

Arrows never give Anubis. It is only found in $(place)desert pyramid$() chests.$(br2)Possessed mobs fight with it, but it never drops from them.$(br2)Once bound, $(warn)any sword you hold$() is Anubis.
Sneak and right click twice to let Anubis go. It goes back into the sword as an item.$(br2)$(warn)If another player kills you while you carry Anubis, it drops for them.$()
